meta.description: Each object is JSON-Schema valid by design. It requires authorization, lifecycle, correlation, or late-result semantic rejection outside JSON Schema. Do not report these as Schema failures.

cases.description: A bundle and its evidence carry different household IDs; the API authorization layer must reject it.
A bundle has an evidence record for a different subject; a structural parser cannot infer the approved subject context.
The tombstone is structurally valid, but a lifecycle guard must prevent its ID from entering a new provider request.
A structurally valid provider result with runId run_succeeded_demo must be dropped when the current job run has already been cancelled or superseded.
A structurally valid review request may still be rejected when authorityRef is no longer valid or expectedRevision is stale.
A structurally valid result must be rejected if its inputHash differs from the persisted job run inputHash.
